title: Wednesdays
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

I heard that it is Wednesday today, the "long week" day.
You’re halfway up the hill, dreaming of the weekend already.

Me? I take it one nap at a time.
Stretch, snack, rest, repeat.
That’s how you survive the middle,
not by rushing through it, but by pausing in it.

You don’t have to climb the whole mountain today.
Just find a sunny spot halfway up.
